reviews.text: Adrian and his team built us the pool of our dreams. Beautiful and unique pool with shiny elevated spa, plenty of free swimming length and nice tanning ledges. We appreciated working with the team, Adrian always gave us a heads up in advance and remained in touch throughout and even after the build for our questions. Special thanks to Joe, who helped us guiding through the day to day process itself, excellent work! We are glad we chose Platinum Pools, definitively a highly recommended custom pool  builder in the DFW area. His staff was professional and responsive if we had questions. I recommend Platinum Pools if you are looking forward to build a custom / high end pool and backyard. I think the photos speak for themselves.

reviews.author: JR Conder

reviews.text: I cannot say enough about Adrian and his crew, especially Daniel. I was worried about the construction process and having dogs. They made a temporary fence, always put the fence panels back up, and it was the least stressful construction project I have had at my home. My pool is very unique, beautiful, a real piece of art in my backyard. Adrian is always responsive if I have a question or need (even things that are not related to just his pool work). Daniel became like a family member. Always on time, worked hard, and did a gorgeous job. Everyone comments on how spectacular my pool is.
reviews.author: Melissa Chartier

reviews.text: This company was fantastic for our backyard remodel! The owner of the company, Adrian, used his expertise to help us come up with a plan to update our dated backyard and pool. He didn’t try to upsell us on things that we were not looking to change. If I had any questions or concerns, i would a get response immediately. I could not have asked for a better experience! I highly recommend them!!!
reviews.author: EM Collett

reviews.text: First off Adrian, the owner, is a great guy.  The flexibility he offers during the build process to make changes on the fly is great.  And Daniel, his main masonry guy does fantastic work!  He actually cares about the quality of the work and ensures your happiness with the final product.  I would definitely recommend Platinum Pools for your next outdoor project!
reviews.author: Chris Bryant

reviews.text: The Platinum Pool team worked with us to retile our waterfall area due to freeze damage!  End result is superior to the original work.  Recommend Platinum Pools to my neighbors.  Thank you to Adrian and team!
reviews.author: Paul Gardner

reviews.text: The 1st thing that grabbed our attention......... they showed up when they said they would. Next, a bid with drawing was presented when they said it would be. We had other bids, but none as detailed as theirs. There price was fair, the finished project a real work of art and the quality was exceptional. What really separates Platinum Pools & Outdoor Living is their follow up to ensure that everything they did continues to please. Thank you and BRAVO!!!!
reviews.author: Ralph Williams

reviews.text: I would recommend Platinum Pools for any of your pool renovation or upgrade needs. They were very communicative during the whole process and met the deadlines they promised based on the things they could control. We love the results and can’t wait to enjoy our pool this summer!
reviews.author: George Cisneros
